# HirePulse Interactive Labs & WebMCP Tools

> 8 Interactive client-side web applications and WebMCP evaluators for AI agents and developers.
> Live Hub: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/

## Available Labs

1. SerpApi to MCP Migrator: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/serpapi-to-mcp-migrator/
   - Code converter and cost calculator for migrating Google Jobs and Ads to HirePulse MCP.
2. YouTube RAG Chunker Lab: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/youtube-rag-chunker-lab/
   - Real-time timestamped transcript chunking for LangChain, LlamaIndex and Claude agents.
3. SEO Keyword Intent Matrix: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/seo-keyword-intent-matrix/
   - Interactive matrix for monthly volume, CPC, difficulty, and domain SEO traffic.
4. B2B Intent Cost Calculator: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/b2b-intent-cost-calculator/
   - Compare multi-source waterfall costs against $0.03 Company Intent Radar runs.
5. ATS Schema Explorer: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/ats-schema-explorer/
   - Inspect open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters.
6. Google Ads Longevity Lab: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/google-ads-longevity-lab/
   - Explore active Google Ads by domain, longevity days, and creative formats.
7. MCP Token Diet Benchmark: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/mcp-token-diet-benchmark/
   - Context window token consumption comparisons for AI agent tool routing.
8. AliExpress Landed Margin Lab: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/labs/aliexpress-landed-margin-lab/
   - Search products, compare ratings/volumes, and calculate dropship margins.

## Remote MCP Server
Connect agents directly via:
- https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/company-intent-radar,hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper,hirepulse/ats-job-pulse,hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper,hirepulse/keyword-search-volume,hirepulse/domain-seo-overview,hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper,hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper
